name: Uttar Pradesh

nextRevision.basis: Uttar Pradesh adjusts the variable dearness allowance for the 74 scheduled employments every 1 April and 1 October, from the six-monthly average consumer price index. The basic rates are interim relief under the 17 April 2026 order. The state notified the Uttar Pradesh Code on Wages Rules, 2026 on 12 August 2026, so new rates may also come under the Code.

tables.title: Scheduled employments
tables.appliesTo: Workers in every employment where minimum wages are fixed under the Minimum Wages Act, 1948 (the state's 74 scheduled employments). Piece-rate wages in brick kilns stay under the earlier order.

zones.name: Category I
zones.areas: Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida, Greater Noida) and Ghaziabad districts.

zones.name: Category II
zones.areas: Districts with a Nagar Nigam (municipal corporation): Agra, Aligarh, Ayodhya, Bareilly, Firozabad, Gorakhpur, Jhansi, Kanpur Nagar, Lucknow, Mathura, Meerut, Moradabad, Prayagraj, Saharanpur, Shahjahanpur and Varanasi.

tables.dailyRule: The October 2026 memo states daily rates: no less than 1/26 of basic wage plus VDA. Part-time workers (under 6 hours a day or 36 a week) get no less than 1/8 of the daily rate an hour.

groups.title: All 74 scheduled employments
employments: Rubber and rubber products, including tyres and tubes
Dams, embankments, irrigation projects, wells and ponds
Every registered factory not named elsewhere
Private hospitals and nursing homes, private clinics and medical stores
Tin plate shaping and tin printing
Engineering units with fewer than 50 workers
Private coaching classes and private schools, including nursery schools and technical institutions
Forestry, logging and timber work, including collecting forest produce and carrying it to market
Road construction and maintenance, and building operations
Ice candy and ice cream units
Asbestos cement and other cement product units
Silk sari weaving on handloom and zari work
Washing and toilet soap, silicate, soap powder and detergent
Security guards of private security agencies, armed or unarmed
Taxis, autorickshaws, tempos and travel agencies
Any establishment not covered by another scheduled employment
groups.note: The April 2026 order covers the state's 74 scheduled employments. The list is the one in the Labour Commissioner's VDA order of 1 October 2024, the latest on the department's site. Brick-kiln workers on time rates use these rates; piece rates are below. Sweeping and cleaning excludes work banned under the Manual Scavengers Act, 1993.

employments: Brick kilns: piece rates for pathera, bharaiwala and nikasi wala
groups.note: Basic rate plus VDA, set for 1 April to 30 September 2026 by the Labour Commissioner's order of 25 March 2026, which the April 2026 order keeps in force for brick-kiln piece rates. The October 2026 VDA memo covers time rates only; no October piece-rate order has been published. The department has not put the order on its website; the copy linked is a scan of the signed order published by a compliance firm.

employments: Agriculture, including farm forestry, dairy farming, livestock, beekeeping and poultry
groups.note: From 1 April 2025, for the whole state, outside the 74 employments. Part of it may be paid in kind if the total is not less. The department has not put the notification on its website; the copy linked is a scan of the signed notification published by a compliance firm. No later agriculture notification has been found.
Hotels and restaurants have their own rates, by unit size and for star hotels, with VDA revised each April and October. The last order on the department's website ran to 31 March 2025.

employments: Carpet weaving, for workers not on piece rates
groups.note: Carpets have their own rates with VDA. The last order on the department's website ran to 31 March 2025.

employments: Glass bangles, for workers not on piece rates
groups.note: Glass bangles have their own rates with VDA. The last order on the department's website ran to 31 March 2025.
Bidi work has its own time rates with VDA and its own piece rates. The last orders on the department's website ran to March and August 2025.

employments: Engineering factories with 50 or more workers
groups.note: These are paid under separate government wage settlements with their own DA, not under the minimum wage orders. The department's memos give only the price index, not rate tables.

history.note: Same basic wage and categories, with VDA at the July to December 2025 index of 425.
One statewide rate, before the April 2026 split into three categories. The orders in between are not on the Labour Department's site.

verification: 2026-10-16: uplabour.gov.in home page news ticker links 'Revised minimum wages basic rates with VDA in 74 scheduled employment, effective from 01/04/2026' (document-34.pdf, English) and the Hindi original (document-33.pdf). Both PDFs carry a text layer, created 17 April 2026.

2026-10-16: document-34.pdf read in full. Order No. 374/36-2-2026-2041256, Lucknow, 17-04-2026, signed Dr. M.K. Shanmuga Sundaram, Principal Secretary. Category I (Gautam Buddha Nagar and Ghaziabad): unskilled 12885 + 805 = 13690; semi-skilled 14173 + 886 = 15059; skilled 15876 + 992 = 16868. Category II (districts having Nagar Nigam, other than those two): 12241 + 765 = 13006; 13464 + 842 = 14306; 15082 + 943 = 16025. Category III (other districts): 11629 + 727 = 12356; 12791 + 799 = 13590; 14328 + 896 = 15224. Effective from 01-04-2026.

2026-10-16, re-read: document-34.pdf preamble. Para 1 cites the outcome of talks 'arising out of the labour unrest in Noida and Greater Noida in Gautam Buddha Nagar district'. The classification para: 'keeping in view the geographical diversification of Uttar Pradesh, status of industries, urban infrastructure and cost of living, the Department of Labour has proposed classification of the State into three categories ... This proposal has been agreed upon by both employers and workers'. The operative para supersedes Labour Commissioner's order 1477-84 (M.W.)/15 dated 25.03.2026, 'except in respect of employment in brick kilns where wages are fixed on piece-rate basis', and applies 'in those employments where minimum wages are otherwise fixed under the Minimum Wages Act, 1948'. The order names no districts beyond Category I and has no annexure.

2026-10-16: Category II districts are the districts (जनपद) of the 17 Nagar Nigams listed by the Directorate of Local Bodies, Uttar Pradesh (localbodies.up.nic.in/listnn.htm, mayors elected in 2023), less Ghaziabad: Ayodhya, Aligarh, Agra, Kanpur Nagar, Gorakhpur, Jhansi, Prayagraj, Firozabad, Bareilly, Mathura (Mathura-Vrindavan), Meerut, Moradabad, Lucknow, Varanasi, Shahjahanpur, Saharanpur. Gautam Buddha Nagar has no Nagar Nigam; the order names it in Category I.
2026-10-16: document-33.pdf (Hindi) tables match the English translation figure for figure.

2026-10-16: VDAin74niyojan011024.pdf (scanned, read by eye). Daily rate no less than 1/26 of basic plus VDA, hourly no less than 1/6 of daily. From 1.10.2024 to 31.3.2025: unskilled 10701 per month and 412 per day, semi-skilled 11772 and 453, skilled 13186 and 507. Issued as 801-07 Pravartan-(M.W.)/15 dated 01/10/2024 by the Office of the Labour Commissioner, Kanpur.
Daily rates for April 2026 are derived: monthly total / 26, rounded up to the paisa (e.g. 13690 / 26 = 526.538 -> 526.54).

2026-10-17: VDAin74niyojan011024.pdf (order 801-07 Pravartan-(M.W.)/15 of 1 October 2024, Hindi scan, pages 1-2 read by eye at 200 dpi) lists the 74 scheduled employments (1-24 on page 1, 25-74 on page 2); the page names them in plain English. Order 374/36-2-2026-2041256 is titled for the 74 scheduled employments and supersedes the 74-employment order 1477-84 (M.W.)/15 of 25 March 2026, which is not online, so the 2024 list is the latest official one. Its operative words ('those employments where minimum wages are otherwise fixed under the Minimum Wages Act') are read as the 74; separately notified employments have their own orders. In the 2024 order's brick-kiln table, time-rated unskilled and skilled kiln workers get the general rates.

2026-10-17: uplabour.gov.in/Pages/MWA.aspx lists 33 VDA circulars, newest 19/02/2025. The latest separate orders online for hotels and restaurants (2075-81, 16 October 2024), carpets (815-21), glass bangles (822-28) and bidi (808-14, piece rates to 29 August 2025) all ran to 31 March 2025; no later orders are posted, so the page shows no figures for them. Agriculture: Page/GO.aspx has notification 02/2024/707/36-03-2024-1619905 of 9 July 2024 (all-inclusive, from 1 April 2024); a July 2025 notification (02/2025/8181/36-03-2025-1619905) is listed by third parties but not on the site, so no agriculture figure is shown. Engineering factories with 50+ workers and vacuum pan sugar mills are paid DA under government settlement notifications (4/2016/873/36-1-2016-549(ST)/8 of 14 September 2016; 1305/36-2-2022-8/2004-TC of 29 June 2022); the memos online give only the index point.
2026-10-17: no wage order newer than 17 April 2026 on the home ticker, the LatestUpdates feed (2025-26, 2026-27), MWA.aspx or the GO list. No October 2026 VDA order is posted.

2026-10-17: order 1477-84 Pravartan-(M.W.)/15 of 25 March 2026 is not on uplabour.gov.in; SGCMS (sgcms.com, a compliance firm) publishes a two-page scan (74-niyojan.pdf, sha256 83e4d607...). Read by eye at 110 dpi: index 425 (base 216), 1 April to 30 September 2026; unskilled 5750 + 5563.65 = 11313.65; brick kilns: time-rated unskilled and skilled as rows 1 and 3; pathera 365 + 353.13 = 718.13, bharaiwala up to 500 m 110 + 106.42 = 216.42, over 500 m 132 + 127.71 = 259.71, nikasi wala 110 + 106.42 = 216.42, per thousand. Page 2: the list of 74 employments and 'संख्या 1477-84 प्रवर्तन-(एम0डब्लू0)/15 दिनांक 25/03/2026', digitally signed Markandeya Sahi 25-03-2026 18:02:41. The number matches the order that 374/36-2-2026-2041256 supersedes; the October 2025 (386, index 414) and April 2025 (2128-35, index 413) orders SGCMS also publishes reproduce from the same base-216 rule.

2026-10-17: agriculture notification 02/2025/818/36-03-2025-1619905 of 17 July 2025 is not on uplabour.gov.in; Simpliance publishes a two-page scan (sha256 64760ea8...). Read by eye: Shram Anubhag-3, supersedes 02/2024/707 of 9 July 2024, from 1 April 2025, whole of Uttar Pradesh, all-inclusive Rs 6552 a month or Rs 252 a day for the three kinds of agricultural work; hourly rate not less than 1/6 of the daily; digitally signed Shanmuga Sundaram 17-07-2025. Simpliance lists the number as .../8181/...; the scan reads 818. CMV360 (28 July 2025) reports the same figures.

2026-10-26: uplabour.gov.in/lc/ (the Labour Commissioner's site) home ticker links 'Revised minimum wages basic rates with VDA in. 74 scheduled employment, effective from 01/10/2026' (MediaGallery/TickerScrolls/MinWages_VDAin74sheduledemploymentdated21-10-2026.pdf; 3 pages, Hindi, text layer, created 21-10-2026). The Shram Vibhag home ticker, MWA.aspx and LatestUpdates do not list it. Office memo I/1498869/2026-2041256, Shram Anubhag-02, Lucknow, 21-10-2026, signed Kunal Silku, Special Secretary, copied to the Labour Commissioner against his letter 1579/IRD-2026 of 30-09-2026. Read in full: the 17 April 2026 rates neutralise the CPI (2001=100) to 400; VDA from 01.10.2026 to 31.03.2027 at the January-June 2026 average of 431, e.g. (431 - 400)/400 x 12885 = 998.59. Category I: unskilled 12885 + 998.59 = 13883.59 (daily 533.98), semi-skilled 14173 + 1098.41 = 15271.41 (587.36), skilled 15876 + 1230.39 = 17106.39 (657.94). Category II: 12241 + 948.68 = 13189.68 (507.30); 13464 + 1043.46 = 14507.46 (557.98); 15082 + 1168.86 = 16250.86 (625.03). Category III: 11629 + 901.25 = 12530.25 (481.93); 12791 + 991.30 = 13782.30 (530.09); 14328 + 1110.42 = 15438.42 (593.79). Every VDA equals basic x 31/400 to the paisa. The memo's daily rates are monthly / 26 rounded to the nearest paisa, so the table now uses them as stated. Notes: daily not less than 1/26 of basic plus VDA; part-time (under 6 hours a day or 36 a week) hourly not less than 1/8 of daily; contract labour deemed employed directly by the employer for these rates. AscentHR's copy (ascent-hr.com, 21 October 2026) is the same file, sha256 1145dbb7....

2026-10-26: uplabour.gov.in/lc/ ticker also links CoW459RPH(Shram Anu-3)-2026.pdf: Uttar Pradesh Code on Wages Rules, 2026, notification 1377/36-03-2026-1901341 of 12 August 2026 (UP Gazette Extraordinary, 88 pages), after the draft of 10 March 2026 (426/36-03-2026-1901341); it supersedes the UP Payment of Wages Rules 1936, Minimum Wages Rules 1952 and Code on Wages Rules 2021. The page no longer says the rules are being notified. Brick-kiln piece rates: no October 2026 order found.
